description.narrative: - Identification, screening and selection of 20 SGBV victims, Organize and conduct training to Self-Help groups (SHG) for 3-5 days - Provision of necessary stationery materials for the newly established 2 SHGs; Liasing with training centres to provide short term vocational skill training for 10-15 SGBV survivors on the basis of individual talents and interest - Provision of start-up capital for 20 SGBV survivors, transforming/handing over of the graduating 20 SGBV survivors into the existing legally recognized saving & credit cooperative - 16 SGBV ambassadors trained in substitution of those that left the team for rollout tasks in the community - Establishment of a legally recognized saving & credit cooperative for the graduated 20 SGBV survivors - Construction/Rehabilitation of small market sheds in clusters for project beneficiaries - Strengthen the collaboration with local government stakeholders and others

Identification, screening and selection of 20 SGBV victims, Organize and conduct training to Self-Help groups (SHG) for 3-5 days
